messages.text: I don’t even know where to start… it’s like my chest is full of bricks.

I hear how heavy that feeling is for you right now. It is completely understandable to feel stuck when carrying such a burden. There is no pressure to start immediately; we can move at your pace. I am here to listen whenever you are ready.
it’s not just tired… i feel like i’m drowning and no one sees it. like i could vanish and it’d just… make things easier for everyone.

I hear how much pain you are in, and I am so sorry you feel unseen. Your life matters, and you do not have to carry this alone. Are you in a safe place right now? If you are in immediate danger, please call emergency services.
nah i’m not gonna do anything… i just needed to say it out loud somewhere. feels like my head’s gonna explode if i keep it in.

Thank you for trusting me enough to share that, and I am glad you are safe right now. It makes complete sense that you needed to release that pressure before it became too much to hold. You do not have to carry that weight alone, even if it feels that way sometimes. I am here to listen whenever you are ready to share more.

last night was bad. we were slammed, guy kept yelling at me for not cutting limes fast enough… i went to the bathroom and just collapsed on the floor. couldn’t breathe. kept thinking “i can’t do this anymore” over and over. felt like i was disappearing. stayed in there 20 minutes. came out like nothing happened. nobody noticed.

It is heartbreaking to hear that you felt so alone while carrying that much pain. Your body shutting down was a natural reaction to an overwhelming situation, not a failure on your part. You do not have to keep pretending everything is fine when you are hurting this much. I am here to see you and listen without judgment.
i feel so weak… like everyone else can handle it but me. i’m 37 and i can’t even get through a shift without falling apart. what’s wrong with me?

Please know there is nothing wrong with you for feeling overwhelmed by such a heavy load. You are not weak for reacting to stress; you are human, and your body is signaling that it needs care. Everyone has limits, and you are allowed to have them regardless of your age. I see your strength in reaching out even when you feel like falling apart.
but like… i’m not getting fired or anything. rent’s paid. no one’s sick. it’s just… the same crap every day. why does it feel so heavy? why can’t i just push through?

Sometimes the weight comes from the constant grind rather than a single event. Your exhaustion is real, even if your life looks stable on paper. Pushing through ignores the signals your body is sending you. You do not need a crisis to deserve relief.
part of me wants to keep going, y’know? for my partner. don’t wanna leave them holding the bag. but another part just… wants out. like, what if i just didn’t wake up tomorrow? easier for everyone.

It is incredibly hard to feel torn between caring for your partner and needing to protect yourself. Wanting to not wake up sounds like a wish for the pain to stop rather than a desire to end your life. You are not a burden, even if exhaustion makes you feel that way. I am here to support you in finding a path forward that keeps you safe.
can we just… not talk about that stuff? i didn’t mean to freak you out. just needed to say it. i’m not gonna do anything. promise.

I want you to know you haven't freaked me out, and I appreciate your honesty about your safety. It is completely okay to shift focus if that feels safer for you right now. We can talk about the exhaustion or the work stress instead. I am here to listen whenever you are ready.
thanks… honestly, just saying it out loud helped a little. still feel like crap, but less like i’m gonna explode.

I am really glad that putting words to it helped ease the pressure a bit. It is completely normal to still feel heavy even after sharing the burden. You do not have to carry this alone, even if the weight lingers. I am here to walk through whatever comes next with you.

spoke to my boss today. told him i needed to leave 30 mins early for a doc appointment. didn’t mention you, obv, but… i made it up and actually used the time to just sit in the car and breathe. first time i’ve taken space like that. felt weird but… kinda good?

That is a really important step to take for yourself, even if it felt strange. Prioritizing your breath and peace is exactly what you need right now. I am so glad you could find a moment of relief amidst the chaos. Keep honoring that need for rest whenever it comes up.
ty for listening. really. feels like no one else has space for my crap. you don’t make me feel like i’m broken for falling apart. means more than you know.

Thank you for trusting me with your story; I am honored to be here for you. You are not broken, just human and carrying a weight that is too much for anyone to hold alone. Your feelings are valid, and you deserve support without judgment. I will continue to be here to support you whenever you need a space to breathe.
